What’s happening in India:

India’s GDP growth forecast for FY25 dips to 6.4% (4-yr low) vs. 8.2% in FY24. Slower growth in key sectors offsets gains in agriculture & public admin. Private consumption to rise 7.3%.

Tata Elxsi & CSIR-NAL team up for advanced air mobility projects, focusing on UAVs, UAM, & eVTOLs. A boost for India's aerospace innovation & global competitiveness.

Tata Technologies partners with Telechips to advance software-defined vehicles via cutting-edge automotive semiconductor solutions.

Zydus' CUTX-101 gets priority review from FDA for Menkes disease. Decision by Jun 2025 could mark the first approved therapy for this rare condition.

L&T PT&D wins major orders in India & Middle East, including smart grids & EHV substations. Strengthens global power infrastructure footprint.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
Birlasoft joins UK's G-Cloud 14 framework, expanding its role in public sector digital transformation with specialized cloud services.

Shakti Pumps to raise ₹400 crore via QIP for strategic expansions, pending approvals.

Biocon Biologics hits $1B revenue milestone in its first year as a global biosimilar leader, operating across 120+ countries.

M&M boosts production by 20% in Dec, hitting 53,361 units. SUVs drive 24% YoY growth in dealer dispatches.

SEBI updates norms for inactive brokerage accounts, aligning settlements with monthly/quarterly schedules. Aimed at procedural efficiency.

NTPC launches India’s first bamboo-coal thermal project in Solapur, blending clean energy with rural bamboo farming support.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text: MobiKwik Q2FY25: Payment GMV soared 267.3% YoY. Net loss at ₹3.6 crore, driven by investment-led growth. Strong financial momentum despite losses. https://t.co/kOyKClQBNZ

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
India's car industry starts 2025 with ~5.5 lakh unsold units worth ₹55,000 crore as 2024 retail sales (40.74 lakh) lag behind dispatches (42.86 lakh). Subdued demand weighs on inventory.

Paras Defence jumps 10% on DPIIT lifetime license to produce MK-46/48 LMGs (6,000 units each annually). Order book now exceeds ₹850 crore, boosting defence portfolio.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
Wockhardt expects ₹400 crore revenue from Miqnaf (pneumonia antibiotic) over 2-3 years. Launching FY26 with ₹70-80 crore initial target.

Vodafone Idea gears up for phased 5G rollout, adding 46,000 sites in 2024. Partnering with Ericsson, Nokia, & Samsung to boost network by March 2025.

Happy Forgings approves ₹650 crore expansion into heavyweight components & industrial segments with a new Asian facility.
